purpose: LM2 (EXPLORATORY): which model that fits a 128 GB machine to run, and what 2-bit and 3-bit quantization cost DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 against its 8-bit reference on verifiable tasks (the dossier's G4 at task level). All runs on the H100 host with stock llama.cpp b11669 (CUDA); the Mac is only the target spec.
refuse_gpu_uuids_reason: physical GPU 0 of the host, held by another project's job (D110, D127); the driver stops before loading anything if it is visible

math.numeric_reference_rule: keep an arxivmath item only if its reference answer evaluates to a number under G3's checker v2 (harness.g3_state_precision.evaluate after normalize_math); symbolic answers with free variables are dropped because the checker compares them only as strings
math.scoring: the last \boxed{} of the final answer (content after the reasoning), checked with harness.g3_state_precision.math_equiv (G3 checker v2)

code.scoring: LiveCodeBench extraction (text between the last two lines containing ```); every public and private test must pass (6 s wall per test, first failure stops), run CPU-only in a no-network, no-GPU, read-only container (scripts/lm2_code_grader.py)

knowledge.scoring: the last 'Answer: X' line of the final answer against the reference letter (10-option multiple choice)

order.rule: within a task, items sorted by the SHA-256 of their id and shuffled with random.Random(42); tasks alternate one item at a time; the seeds of an item are adjacent; a budget cut keeps a prefix of each task's permutation (--cap task=N)

slot_sizing_note: Pilot starting points from HBM arithmetic: MoE decode reads most expert weights once per step once the batch is large, so more slots raise throughput until compute or KV memory binds; layer split runs the GPUs one after another, so throughput per GPU-hour is set by slots per step. Qwen3-235B's f16 KV (188 KiB per token) limits it to about 14 slots on 2 GPUs, so it gets 3 GPUs and 32 slots; gpt-oss-120b's 13 GiB of free memory on 1 GPU allows about 10 slots, so it gets 2 GPUs and 48. The driver's --slots overrides a value after the pilot, and the manifest records it.
